description: The rule covers a <channel> body (ruled S441 item 2): loose prose is E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT.
rationale: §40.8 S441 bullet (ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S441 "prose should be declared as such" + "declared-prose implementation: yes to all four"): a `<program>` / `<page>` / `<channel>` body is a code-default body — a bare run there is code, checked exactly as inside `${ … }`, never page text; displayed text is declared by a markup element or a `"..."` display-text literal; a bare run that is not valid code is E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT.
